explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 61 named tracks, current release cuts and overlooked catalogue selections across Boomkat's September 11 new-release field, current electronic and techno/house pages, and adjacent dub, experimental-song and instrumental-guitar windows. Written metadata and attributed exact-track descriptions only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Turning Jewels Into Water's Morning Birds and Distant Drums and Regina Collage's Horizont appeared in Boomkat's 11 September 2026 field with differentiated exact-track descriptions. https://boomkat.com/products/morning-birds-and-distant-drums · https://boomkat.com/products/horizont

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Regina Collage's distorted machine-song forms and Dean McPhee's looping, unusual-meter guitar work supplied candidate-specific structural questions outside a single techno production world. https://boomkat.com/products/horizont · https://boomkat.com/products/northern-earth

OVERLOOKED / CATALOGUE WINDOW: Black Steel's 1988 Jungle Warrior and Soichi Terada's early-1990s Far East Recording material were considered through current reissue circulation, without nostalgia or prestige credit. https://boomkat.com/products/jungle-warrior-971e87c8-390c-434d-ab03-008539582a78 · https://boomkat.com/products/sounds-from-the-far-east-2025-edition
exclusions: Run 207's entire source field, recent Runs 201–207 fields, every prior ranked lead and alternate, canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, and existing global utility identities were excluded.

The five-run repetition check avoided every exact placement boundary proposed in completed exploration Runs 201, 202, 203, 206 and 207. Current placements are candidate-specific questions, not a boundary-distribution quota.
Nine leads survived because each has differentiated exact-track evidence and a concrete transition/local-run/long-form question; no list slot was padded.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
